scope: read-only Chromium Linux desktop profiling; source debug warp to stop, native E transfer and keyboard walking

conditions.instrumentation: named main RAF/function timings and JSON clones; inclusive overlapping totals; not CPU trace or thermal benchmark

timingLimits: Function/JSON wrappers add instrumentation cost. Inclusive timings overlap and must not be summed. Shared host/headless scheduling and cache cold-start stalls cannot be translated into phone frame rate.
